top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation by induced proximity turns ubiquitin-dependent proteolysis into a defined chemical reaction (a small-molecule-induced ternary complex with an E3 ligase) and gives biologists a transferable design rule. Key claims are independently reproduced, with solved VHL and cereblon ternary structures. The induced-proximity citation keeps the glue strand inside the stated principle within a three-name cap. I weigh the lack of an approved degrader drug as a timing weakness, but the chemical and structural validation is complete. Buchwald-Hartwig C-N coupling is mature and cleanly attributed, so it is a close second.
